chapter: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band
title: Daily rehearsals and Sunday school playing
summary: Pupils had to attend rehearsal every day after school; on Sundays the band played an overture and hymns like "Onward Christian Soldiers" for the whole Sunday school.

bands.name: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Well, what did you -- you told Stan that
for her to accept you you had to agree that you'd come after school every day?
Oh, yeah, you had to come to band rehearsal.
Every day she had band rehearsal?
Every day was band -- no, on Sunday you played. Saturday you didn't go. But Sunday you played all day in Sunday school.
And you played one overture, one overture, and then you played all the church music. "What a Friend We Have in Jesus," "Abide With Me," and, "Onward Christian Soldiers."
Did you play for the services?
We played while everybody sings, yeah.
The whole Sunday school would sing.
And then we went to different rooms, as I told you about. We'd play, "Onward Christian Soldiers." You know.
And then you played an overture, one overture, and -- every Sunday. So you'd practice that during the week and you played it on Sunday.
